title: Resolved owner settings contract (design; runtime not implemented)

viewport.description: Replaces aspectRatio→pixel mappings in both solver and renderer; only Context owns dimensions.

fontMetrics.description: Each usable family/weight is an immutable asset. Closure must resolve an exact declared asset; the fixture identities are illustrative only.

coordinateDecimals.description: Replaces .2f; round only during serialization, never routing.

fontPolicy.description: Unsupported embedding/outlining is a capability error, never silent fallback.

overflow.description: Required accessible content may not be clipped.

fontFamily.description: One declared stack; no local hardcoded font fallback.

varianceUnknown.description: Explicit role paint; no adapter fallback color.

tableHeader.description: Explicit role paint; no adapter fallback color.

groupBand.description: Explicit role paint; no adapter fallback color.

rowShade.description: Explicit role paint; no adapter fallback color.

groupPaints.description: Stable group IDs map to paint; empty map uses groupBand.

facetPaints.description: Facet-paint resolution is groups[groupId][facet], then default[facet], then normalized global role; group background paint remains groupPaints.

annotation.description: Concrete shared annotation paints; Layout owns candidate geometry and routing limits.

bar.description: Replaces rounded corners, minimum widths, and all legacy bar heights.

point.description: Size is full bounding diameter/width; ports derive from selected shape.

arrow.description: Normalized path is a shape algorithm, not user-authored SVG; ref point derives from dimensions.

varianceMarkerWidth.description: Marker height derives from paired bars, not independent duplicated setting.

missingPattern.description: Closes legacy hatch spacing, rotation, size and line width.

margins.description: Named compact/balanced/spacious become data presets, not code lookups.

regions.description: No special meaning for header/main/footer IDs; block sizes and tracks are explicit.

scaleId.description: Required by semantic validation for timeline and timeline-axis slots; both must name the same derived scale.

slots.description: Eliminates insertion-index allocation and fallback Rects; shared rows are one derived grid.

group.description: Style controls color; View controls membership/order; no density-triggered semantics.

labelPlacement.description: Finite, deterministic placement candidates; required content may not be clipped.

row.description: Minimum is max(declared minimum, measured content+padding); removes fs*2.8 approximation.

cellPadding.description: Includes wrapped group labels and notes.

columnTracks.description: Empty means equal division by count, an explicit algorithm policy; keyed position follows View columns.

text.description: Remove .58/.34 approximate glyph metrics; baselines use pinned ascent/descent and lineHeight.

title.description: No hand-written title baseline or +30 offset; measured stack.

axis.description: Band heights pair with levels; grid derives chart bounds; tick cadence is display-only.

scale.description: Padding is independent of semantic View window; one scale maps all projected endpoints.

bars.description: Sizes belong to Theme; band placement belongs to Layout.

variance.description: Label obstacle is measured; eliminates +60/+57 and manual baseline +5.

missingActual.description: Measured label obstacle replaces width112; data coverage cannot silently disappear.

routing.description: Semantic endpoint types are NOT configurable; geometry from actual mark bounds and a bounded route search.

lanes.description: Stable stacking uses View group/order and never moves an item across groups.

legend.description: Item advance is measured swatch+label+gap, never 150/145/220/175/180 by label.

notes.description: Typography comes from theme; placement is measured flow, not +20 or fs*1.4.

summary.description: Removes summary-only coordinates, fonts and 15/13px baselines.

labelRules.description: Closed text sources only; source stability, rule order and Layout candidates determine placement.

subtitle.description: Restricted template; dates formatted through declared format catalog.

accessibleDescription.description: Required accessible description uses real facts; no arbitrary expression evaluation.

coverage.description: Coverage facts remain defined by projection, not template.

legend.description: Order and label owned by existing Detail; symbol comes from matching Theme role.

formatting.description: Closed formatter catalog, not strftime code or arbitrary user function.

summaryLabels.description: Metric IDs/values remain existing Summary authority; only labels migrate.
